t: In front of you is Hanover Terrace, a long terrace on the west side of Regent's Park. It overlooks the park, and the whole terrace is Grade I listed, which is the highest level of protection a building can have in England. The English artist and illustrator Dodie Masterman, who lived from 1918 to 2009, lived here. It's a fine place to stop and look across the park at the façade, and think of an illustrator working in such a setting.
